I told Ilse in your DM that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. I got that from the fact I saved in GBrain, and our DM history matches it: she said it on Oct 14 and hasn't changed it since.

One thing to know: GBrain stored that fact with visibility set to "world," not private. My note asking that it stay in your DM is only text attached to the fact, so it doesn't stop anyone from seeing it. Other GBrain readers may be able to find it. If you want it locked down, the brain owner would need to change it.
